extDescription.message: Routes selected sites through a local HTTP, HTTPS, or SOCKS proxy. All other traffic stays direct.

enableProxy.message: Turn the proxy on or off

statusOnEmpty.message: On, but the site list is empty

optionsSubtitle.message: Sends only the sites you list through a local proxy. Everything else stays on a direct connection.

sitesHint.message: One domain per line. Subdomains are included automatically (example.com also matches www.example.com).

listEmpty.message: The list is empty — add a domain above

howBody1.message: Broxy does not include a proxy server. You must already run a local proxy (for example 127.0.0.1:8080).

howBody2.message: When the switch is on and the site list is not empty, Broxy applies a PAC script in the background through the browser proxy API. Listed domains go to your proxy; all other traffic uses DIRECT.

howBody3.message: Turn off the built-in Opera VPN while Broxy is active, or the two tools will fight over proxy settings.

howBody4.message: Turning Broxy off clears its proxy settings and returns control to the browser.

privacyBody.message: Settings stay in this browser (local storage). Broxy does not collect accounts, browsing history, or personal data, and it does not send anything to a remote server.

errorHost.message: Enter a valid hostname or IPv4 address (for example 127.0.0.1).

errorPattern.message: Enter a valid domain (for example example.com).
